workflowBefore:
name: Publish site and neighborhood
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions:
  contents: read
  actions: read
  pages: write
  id-token: write
concurrency:
  group: pages
  cancel-in-progress: false
jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment:
      name: github-pages
      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Preserve the existing public site
        run: |
          mkdir _site
          git archive HEAD | tar -x -C _site
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: bacbaqui-web/our-neighborhood
          ref: d0d319741cee82721d9f2bcd9efd1f3034de0b45
          path: _neighborhood
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
      - name: Check and build neighborhood
        working-directory: _neighborhood
        env:
          VWORLD_WEB_KEY: ${{ secrets.VWORLD_WEB_KEY }}
        run: |
          npm ci --prefix work/browser-generation --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
          node scripts/check-loading.mjs
          node tests/browser-generation.mjs
          node tests/vworld-browser.mjs
          node tests/visible-horizon.mjs
          node tests/visible-horizon-worker.mjs
          python3 -m pip install Pillow==13.0.0
          python3 scripts/build-site.py
      - name: Add neighborhood without changing the main app
        run: |
          cp -R _neighborhood/dist _site/neighborhood
          touch _site/.nojekyll
          cmp index.html _site/index.html
          test -f _site/neighborhood/domestic-test/start.html
      - uses: actions/configure-pages@v5
      - uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v3
        with:
          path: _site
      - name: Wait for uploaded Pages artifact
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          DEPLOY_REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
          DEPLOY_RUN_ID: ${{ github.run_id }}
        run: |
          for attempt in $(seq 1 12); do
            count=$(gh api "repos/$DEPLOY_REPOSITORY/actions/runs/$DEPLOY_RUN_ID/artifacts" --jq '[.artifacts[] | select(.name == "github-pages" and .expired == false)] | length')
            if [ "$count" -gt 0 ]; then exit 0; fi
            sleep 5
          done
          echo "Pages artifact is not yet visible to the deployment API."
          exit 1
      - name: Deploy
        id: deployment
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v4
